STYLE_CLAY_MASTER.description: Chibi-style 3D animation; chunky, toy-like proportions; large expressive eyes; rounded snouts; smooth matte clay/vinyl textures; vibrant saturated colors; friendly and approachable for small children.
STYLE_CLAY_MASTER.base_lighting: Soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to emphasize the physical toy feel.
STYLE_CLAY_MASTER.negative_constraints: No organic skin textures, no scales, no realistic eye anatomy, no sharp predatory features, no naturalistic lighting.

STYLE_SILHOUETTE.lighting: High-contrast backlighting, sun on horizon at dusk
STYLE_SILHOUETTE.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette, zero internal detail, sharp edges
STYLE_SILHOUETTE.background: Solid vibrant sunset orange or high-contrast sky
STYLE_SILHOUETTE.negative_constraints: No internal shading, no transparency, no feathered or fuzzy edges, no gradient fills within the subject.

style_presets.STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film aesthetic. Character-driven design with soulful, expressive eyes and a signature friendly smirk. Surfaces feature tactile, high-quality textures like soft downy feathers or leathery skin with subtle specular highlights. Avoids sharp, aggressive angles in favor of appealing, rounded 'toy-like' forms.

lighting_presets.STUDIO_SOFT: Soft studio lighting, ambient occlusion, gentle shadows
lighting_presets.HIGH_SUN: High-key direct sunlight, bright blue sky, crisp shadows, 12pm lighting
lighting_presets.DAPPLED_OPEN: Bright afternoon sun filtered through thin leaves, warm highlights
lighting_presets.SUNNY_EXPOSED: Direct midday sun, high-key exposure, vibrant blue sky, high albedo ground reflection.
lighting_presets.DUSK_SILHOUETTE: Sun positioned directly behind the subject on the horizon, high-contrast backlighting, subject is 100% black silhouette.
lighting_presets.STUDIO_GROUNDED: Neutral studio lighting, high-contrast contact shadows for weight, 50% grey floor plane.
lighting_presets.DAPPLED_EXCAVATION: Bright sun filtered through temporary dig-site tarps, warm highlights on stone texture.
lighting_presets.SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC: Bright, direct midday sunlight with high-key exposure. Features warm, natural highlights and soft-edged cinematic shadows that emphasize the 3D volume of the dinosaur's body. Maintains a clear, atmospheric perspective with a slight hazy glow in the distant horizon to create depth.

technical_specs.SQUARE_ASPECT_RATIO: Aspect ratio 1:1. Minimum resolution 1024x1024. Designed to support vertical and horizontal elements simultaneously, ideal for dinosaurs with upright postures or dynamic, raised-limb poses like the Karate Kid crane stance.

TALL_MEASUREMENT_CARD.framing_note: Vertical orientation; subject centered with 15% negative space at bottom for UI ladder overlap.

WIDE_WEIGHT_CARD.framing_note: Horizontal orientation; full lateral profile; feet must touch bottom of frame for seesaw grounding.

framing_presets.WIDE_HERO: Extreme wide panoramic shot. The dinosaur's body fills the entire horizontal width. The nose must touch the left frame edge and the tail must touch the right frame edge. Centered vertically.
framing_presets.TALL_MEASURE: Extreme vertical scale. The distance from the top of the head to the bottom of the feet spans the entire 1024 vertical pixels. High-angle or wide-angle view to ensure the face is not cut off by the top edge.
framing_presets.SQUARE_HERO_CARD: Perfectly centered 1:1 square composition. The character is scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space buffer on all four sides. This safety margin prevents any portion of the head, tail, or raised limbs from touching the edges of the frame.
